neighbourhood: Create a distinct original traversable precinct with authored street topology, terrain/elevation, frontage rhythm, residents and environmental sound.
At least two specific spatial affordances and an authored landmark/activity connection make this area recognisable in play; a coloured rectangle or swapped sign is insufficient.
Verify walking/driving access, camera/collision, neighbouring routes, district naming, traffic/pedestrian navigation and mission/side-content integration.
location: Produce original exterior, approach, signage and surrounding public space; preserve the verified source gameplay role and distinguish access class.
For an accessible interior, build actual connected rooms/floors, doors, stairs and functional interactions with collision, camera and actor navigation.
Test entrance, exit, interrupted interaction, actor/vehicle access where applicable, story gating and relevant persistence. A facade or proximity trigger cannot certify an enterable/activity venue.
transport: Create physical connected infrastructure with explicit road/rail/pedestrian/water paths, clearances, entrances and correctly separated height levels.
Routing must follow its actual connection topology and exclude broken/closed/inaccessible links; boarding/vehicle movement cannot be replaced with undeclared teleporting.
Verify traffic/actor traversal, signals/arrival where relevant, pursuit/service restrictions, camera clearance and interruption/recovery.
water: Author a continuous original navigable water body with shoreline, depth/bounds policy, visible crossings and correct land/water collision.
Provide the boating/swimming/shore access required by its missions and activities, with meaningful routes and obstacles.
Verify transitions, rescue/failure, camera and map/GPS consistency; scenery water cannot certify navigable waterfront play.

ambiguities.subject: 65-place headline and prison/island substitution
ambiguities.finding: Fandom neighbourhood table includes Charge Island among56 city labels plus nine Alderney areas. The older 65-locality table lists the correctional facility instead of Charge Island. Both totals65 conceal different members.
ambiguities.resolution: Use65 neighbourhood/island roles and keep the prison as a separate facility record; do not silently lose either island or prison.

ambiguities.subject: Station labels, complexes and levels
ambiguities.finding: Grand Easton Terminal is a landmark around the Easton subway; West Park is a separate operating stop. Huntington Street is a single dual-level complex visited twice by each port/airport loop.
ambiguities.resolution: Keep 26 operating station complexes, explicit level calls, one inactive station and a separate terminal-landmark location record.

ambiguities.subject: C/B direction
ambiguities.finding: The older C/B route-page introduction says clockwise while its detail and the subway overview say counterclockwise.
ambiguities.resolution: Use the ordered reverse inner/Canal circuit and corroborated counterclockwise service directions, flagging the wording discrepancy.

ambiguities.subject: Acter/Tudor bridge names and family versus span counts
ambiguities.finding: The derelict Alderney crossing has fan-assigned Acter and Tudor names; references disagree on its real-world influence. East Borough is one named family containing three physical spans. The adjacent Northwood rail bridge has a descriptive unofficial name.
ambiguities.resolution: One derelict record with both aliases; three explicit interchange spans; independent unnamed/descriptively named rail crossing. Do not interpret the eight-family index as every physical span or the fourteen achievement volumes.

ambiguities.subject: Venue geography and usable-versus-advertised scope
ambiguities.finding: Golden Pier/bowling is labelled Westminster, The Meat Quarter or Purgatory by different activity/locality references. Club Liberty is labelled North Holland or Northwood. Source advertising does not prove that a restaurant permits ordinary public entry.
ambiguities.resolution: Keep physical venues and known access roles, record address/border audits as open, and avoid inventing extra branches from label variants.

ambiguities.subject: Hospital naming and geography
ambiguities.finding: Easton Medical Center, Lancet-Hospital Center and St. Openshaw are one facility. Westdyke Memorial is physically in Leftwood; North Tudor is physically in Acter.
ambiguities.resolution: Count physical facilities once and keep signage/marketing aliases separate from neighbourhood membership.

ambiguities.subject: Miniature versus full landmark and cross-universe contamination
ambiguities.finding: The Big Pecker appears as a miniature-course obstacle, not the seaside observation wheel; that wheel is Liberty Eye. The base park pillar is Middle Park Obelisk, while Liberty City War Memorial is a different-universe equivalent. The two Alderney financial offices are separate buildings.
ambiguities.resolution: Corrected the draft city records, separated the financial sites and enumerated miniature-course objects. All records remain planned.

ambiguities.subject: Civic Citadel three-place nickname and port agency/site conflation
ambiguities.finding: Civic Citadel refers to city hall in a mission, Woodworld Building on a printed map and a Municipal Building replica in an aerial activity. Port authority HQ is Pier D in Port Tudor, while the water-escort LCPA dock is a separate Alderney City site.
ambiguities.resolution: Qualified the city-hall alias, preserved two distinct tower candidates, separated authority headquarters/city dock/Normandy waterfront, and corrected the westward bridge endpoint to Leftwood.

known_gaps.needed: Record every operating station entrance/exit, platform/level assignment, street connection and restricted maintenance access. Source route labels/ordered sequences are now identified; exact portal/level geometry and the earlier systems station-label correction remain open.

known_gaps.needed: Map all 200 collectibles,50 stunt lines,14 under-bridge volumes and five aerial tour routes to distinct original authored locations; named bridge families or source totals do not certify placement coverage.

known_gaps.needed: Associate all source-mapped 90 story titles/branches and researched side encounters with every relevant physical site, route and stage; selected named scene locations are only a starting inventory.

known_gaps.needed: Classify appearances and access by original base GTA IV versus its episodes, Chinatown Wars, removed content, cutscene dressing and scenery. Shared category membership alone cannot add or remove a usable base requirement.

known_gaps.subject: Exact source neighbourhood borders
known_gaps.needed: Reconcile spatial zone labels and border-changing businesses/entrances against primary in-game evidence where possible. The65-name baseline preserves identities; the fan neighbourhood overlay is not authoritative for every boundary.

known_gaps.subject: Original asset and world production
known_gaps.needed: Author final original street/building/shore/interior geometry, scene choreography, portal coordinates, signage, audio, inhabitants and affordances for every retained record; a generated labelled footprint does not implement the city.

known_gaps.needed: Extend the separate character research to named and ambient city inhabitants, public-service staff, performance/media cast and world behaviours. This task does not close the existing character inventory gap.
